title: Add Spillover Gateway and SLO Anticipator for regional failover stability
author: Maya Ramos
release_notes: Introduces a regional spillover admission gateway and an SLO Anticipator that proactively reserves token budgets and warms KV cache. Improves regional failover smoothness and reduces noisy circuit flips. No customer-facing API changes.
description: Context: During a recent multi-region pressure incident we observed fast cascade failovers when a region hit transient GPU KV pressure. Root causes included bursty egress and late detection of SLO drift, which triggered aggressive circuit flips and mass tenant rebalancing. This PR implements two orthogonal mitigations: a lightweight Spillover Gateway that provides controlled regional spill routing, and an SLO Anticipator that uses short-window telemetry to preemptively apply smoothing actions. Motivation: Reduce noisy circuit transitions, keep hot KV cached where possible, and avoid wholesale tenant migrations that amplify load spikes. Goals: 1) Provide a low-latency path to route overflow requests to neighboring regions when local SLOs are at risk, honoring tenant affinity and KV preservation heuristics. 2) Predict imminent SLO violations (latency and error rate) with a short look-ahead model and trigger token-budget reservation, prefetch of KV prefixes, and adaptive batch relaxation. 3) Keep behavioral controls per-tenant and per-route so enterprise customers can opt-in to spillover or pin to local-only behavior. Summary of changes: - runtime/spillover/gateway.go: new Spillover Gateway component that exposes an internal route decision API and integrates with the smart routing layer. Adds circuit-aware pacing and KV-preserve hint headers. - routing/policy/spillover_policy.yaml: default policy config (region adjacency weights, per-tenant opt-in, max spill ratio). - telemetry/anticipator/service.py: lightweight anticipator service (stateless window aggregator + simple exponential smoothing model) and a REST hook to the control plane. - runtime/kv/prefetch_manager.go: prefetch hot prefixes on anticipator signal and hold a short-lived soft lock to reduce cold-KV penalties. - orchestration/helm/spillover-values.yaml: gating flags and tunables for Dedicated/Private installs. - tests/integration/spillover_e2e_test.go: deterministic e2e that simulates KV pressure and verifies no noisy mass failovers. - docs/ops/spillover.md: operational runbook, thresholds, and rollback steps.
